summary: Delta Air Lines filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $500 million offering of 5.500% senior unsecured notes due 2029, priced at 99.855% of par (0.500% underwriting discount; $496.775 million net proceeds before expenses), with settlement expected on or about November 6, 2026. Interest pays semi-annually beginning May 6, 2027; the notes are redeemable at stated prices and carry a 101% change-of-control put. BofA, Citi, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs and others are joint book-running managers. This is a routine investment-grade-style debt takedown, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing commentary.
